title: pellaea aspera
intro: Pellaea aspera, commonly known as Rough Shield Fern, is a species of fern in the family Pteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pellaea aspera include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which contribute to its use in treating wounds and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Pellaea aspera include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
